description: This Java class 'ConstraintValidator' configures and provides validation logic for data objects, including custom constraint mappings and validation methods, within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: ConstraintValidator
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that sets up custom validation constraints and provides static methods for validating data objects.

methods.name: validateFields
methods.description: Validates the given data object; throws DataValidationException if violations are found.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates a string error message from a collection of constraint violations.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message for a single constraint violation, including property name if available.

methods.name: initializeValidators
methods.description: Configures Hibernate Validator with custom constraint mappings and initializes the static validator instance.

methods.name: validatorFactoryBean
methods.description: Creates and configures a LocalValidatorFactoryBean with custom constraint mappings.

methods.name: getCustomConstraintMapping
methods.description: Defines custom validation constraints and their validators for the application.
